location_description:
Lake Ronkonkoma is a hamlet and census-designated place (CDP) in Suffolk County, on Long Island, in New York, United States. The population was 20,155 at the 2010 census.Lake Ronkonkoma is mainly located in the Town of Brookhaven, but has small sections in the Town of Smithtown and the Town of Islip.


== History ==

The actual lake, Lake Ronkonkoma, adjacent to the CDP, is the largest lake on Long Island.
